_comment: Countries where mid-level developer pay, converted to USD, clears $28,000/year ($1,533/month). Static, manually researched list, not a live feed. Review every few months. A posting with no specific country requirement ('Remote, Worldwide') always passes regardless of this list.

excluded_with_reason.Russia: Clears the salary floor but most sources this system pulls from don't process hires or payments there due to sanctions.
excluded_with_reason.India: Only MNC/FAANG-adjacent roles clear the floor; typical local pay is well under it, and job data doesn't label 'MNC vs local' cleanly.
excluded_with_reason.Philippines: Typical pay is well under the floor.

notes: Edit eligible_countries to add/remove a country. Matching is case-insensitive substring matching, see lib/filters.js SYNONYMS for abbreviation handling (UK, US, UAE, Dubai, etc).
